summary: Kanawha County tower site named in a 2022 Gazette-Mail column as one of four county fire towers; registered 2017 and listed gone. No build or removal date found.

facts.status_note: Listed as tower gone on the Forest Fire Lookout Association list.

events.note: Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites Register January 26, 2017; nominated by Brian M. Powell
Charleston Gazette-Mail column (September 17, 2022) names Foreman Knob as one of four Kanawha County fire towers

evidence.supports: Site is in Kanawha County, West Virginia

Register page is the only description of the site; it says nothing about remains or access

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The register page has no description, build date, staffing, or removal date. The only history is a 2022 Gazette-Mail column that names Foreman Knob among four Kanawha County towers, and the Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks it gone. The Forest Lookouts West Virginia page has no Foreman Knob entry. The Gazette page is a subscriber e-edition, but the column text was readable. The story is short (about 110 words) because nothing more is supported. A future pass could check West Virginia Division of Forestry records for a build or removal date.
